theory_html:
2.1. Introductory it as subject
2.1. It giới thiệu làm chủ ngữ

For weather, time, distance, situations (It's raining, It's about 15 kilometres…); as an alternative to a that-, wh-, -ing or to-infinitive clause as subject (It's a pity that…, It's obvious why…, It's an advantage being…, It shocked me to see…). Not usually instead of a noun subject in writing. Patterns: it + verb + to-inf, it + verb + object + to-inf, it + verb + that-clause, it + verb + object + that; formal it + passive + that/wh-clause (It is said that…).

It làm chủ ngữ giả thay mệnh đề that/wh/-ing/to V; It is said that… (trang trọng).

2.2. Introductory it as object
2.2. It giới thiệu làm tân ngữ

verb + it + that/if/wh-clause (I wouldn't like it if…, I couldn't believe it when…); would appreciate it if; accept (it) that; verb + it + adjective + clause (make it clear whether, think it unlikely that); leave/owe it to sb to; see it as essential that.

I'd appreciate it if…; make it clear; leave it to sb to…; see it as essential that….

2.3. There
2.3. There

There + be introduces new information (existence, place) with indefinite nouns (a/an, no article, any, some, no); there, not it, for existence and quantities. Followed by noun + clause (a chance that, plans to), bound/certain/likely/supposed/sure to be; there + modal + be, there seem/appear to be, there is expected to be, expect there to be. Verb agrees with the (first) noun; informal there's + plural.

There + be giới thiệu thông tin mới; động từ hợp với danh từ đầu tiên; There's bound to be…, There seem to be….

2.4. Common expressions with it's no and there's no
2.4. Thành ngữ với it's no / there's no

it's no secret / surprise / wonder / coincidence that, it's no use/good + -ing, it's no longer necessary to, it's no exaggeration to say that…; there's no doubt that, there's no choice but to, there's no need to, there's no point in + -ing, there's no hurry, there's no harm in + -ing…

Các cụm cố định với it's no và there's no.

items.def_en: It used as a grammatical subject referring forward to a clause.
items.def_vi: It làm chủ ngữ ngữ pháp, chỉ tới mệnh đề phía sau.
items.grammar_vi: Introductory it (structure) = it giới thiệu. Grammar: thời tiết, giờ, khoảng cách: It's raining again..

example.en: It's going to be hard to choose between them.

items.def_en: Introductory it instead of a that-clause as subject.
items.def_vi: It thay mệnh đề that làm chủ ngữ.
items.grammar_vi: It's a pity that (structure) = thật tiếc là. Grammar: hơn That the town apartment is so small is a pity..

example.en: It's a pity that the town apartment is so small.
example.vi: Thật tiếc là căn hộ trong phố nhỏ quá.

items.def_en: It + verb + object + that-clause: I suddenly thought that.
items.grammar_vi: It struck me that (structure) = tôi chợt nghĩ. Grammar: It appears that…, It might help to….

example.en: It struck me that the Conley apartment might be quite noisy with that busy road nearby.
example.vi: Tôi chợt nghĩ căn Conley có thể ồn vì đường đông.

items.grammar_vi: It is said that (structure) = người ta nói rằng. Grammar: ít trang trọng: They say that…; It was explained how….

example.en: It is said that the cost of accommodation in the town centre will rise
example.vi: Người ta nói rằng giá nhà trung tâm sẽ tăng.

items.def_en: A polite request with it as object before an if-clause.
items.def_vi: Yêu cầu lịch sự: sẽ rất cảm kích nếu.
items.grammar_vi: Would appreciate it if (structure) = rất cảm kích nếu. Grammar: verb + it + if-clause; I wouldn't like it if….

example.en: I would appreciate it if you could send me further details of the apartment
example.vi: Tôi rất cảm kích nếu ông gửi thêm thông tin căn hộ.

items.def_en: Verb + it + adjective + clause: to state clearly.
items.grammar_vi: Make it clear (structure) = làm rõ. Grammar: trang trọng I think it highly unlikely that….

example.en: The owner didn't make it clear whether they were included in the price.
example.vi: Chủ nhà không nói rõ chúng có được tính vào giá không.

items.def_en: Let someone else be responsible for doing something.
items.grammar_vi: Leave it to sb to (structure) = để ai lo. Grammar: cũng owe it to sb to.

example.en: I think we should leave it to the estate agent to talk to the owner
example.vi: Ta nên để người môi giới lo nói chuyện với chủ nhà.

items.def_vi: Coi điều gì là thiết yếu.
items.grammar_vi: See it as essential that (structure) = coi là thiết yếu. Grammar: verb + it + as + adj + clause.

example.en: I see it as essential that there should be somewhere to park.
example.vi: Tôi coi việc có chỗ đậu xe là thiết yếu.

items.def_en: Introduces new information that something exists or is in a place.
items.def_vi: Giới thiệu thông tin mới: có cái gì ở đâu.
items.grammar_vi: There + be (structure) = có. Grammar: + danh từ không xác định; không There's the car park….

example.en: There's a bus stop just outside the apartment block.
example.vi: Có một trạm xe buýt ngay ngoài khu căn hộ.

items.def_en: There (not it) to say whether things exist or to talk about quantities.
items.def_vi: Dùng there (không phải it) để nói có/không có.
items.grammar_vi: There (not it) (structure) = không có (chỗ). Grammar: không It's nowhere to park; Was there a dishwasher…?.

example.vi: Không có chỗ nào để đậu xe.

items.def_en: There + bound/certain/likely/sure + to be: something will certainly exist.
items.grammar_vi: There's bound to be (structure) = chắc chắn có. Grammar: cũng certain, likely, supposed, sure.

example.en: There's bound to be a regular bus service from there.
example.vi: Chắc chắn có tuyến xe buýt thường xuyên từ đó.

items.grammar_vi: There seem to be (structure) = dường như có. Grammar: There must be someone….

example.en: There seem to be good and bad aspects of each apartment
example.vi: Dường như có mặt tốt và xấu ở mỗi căn.

items.def_en: There + passive reporting verb + to be.
items.def_vi: There + động từ tường thuật bị động + to be.
items.grammar_vi: There is expected to be (structure) = dự kiến sẽ có. Grammar: cũng estimate, find, reckon, report, say, think.

example.en: There is expected to be a lot of interest in the property.
example.vi: Dự kiến sẽ có nhiều người quan tâm đến căn nhà.

items.grammar_vi: Expect there to be (structure) = mong là có. Grammar: = expect many people to be interested.

example.en: I wouldn't expect there to be many people interested in buying the apartment.
example.vi: Tôi không nghĩ sẽ có nhiều người muốn mua căn hộ.

items.def_en: With a list after there, the verb agrees with the first noun.
items.def_vi: Với danh sách, động từ hợp với danh từ đầu tiên.
items.grammar_vi: There was ... and (structure) = có (danh sách). Grammar: There were just some bookshelves, a bed…; thân mật There's so many things….

example.en: There was just a bed, a small wardrobe and some bookshelves.
example.vi: Chỉ có một cái giường, một tủ nhỏ và vài giá sách.

items.grammar_vi: It's no wonder (structure) = chẳng trách. Grammar: cũng it's no secret/surprise/coincidence that, it's no use + V-ing.

example.en: It's no wonder they've been having problems selling the apartment.
example.vi: Chẳng trách họ gặp khó khi bán căn hộ.

items.def_en: There is no need to do something quickly.
items.grammar_vi: There's no hurry (structure) = không cần vội. Grammar: cũng there's no doubt that, no need to, no point in + V-ing, no choice but to.
